task.title: Q3 operating expense variance analysis
task.objective: Explain why Q3 operating expenses came in 11.4% over budget, by cost center, for the CFO's board pre-read.
task.outcome: A one-page variance bridge with the top drivers quantified, each tied to ledger evidence, plus a list of items needing a controller's judgment.

success_criteria.description: Variance bridge reconciles to the reported $2.31M overage within $10k.
Every driver over $50k cites ledger entries or contracts.
Output fits the board pre-read template.

includes: Q3 FY2026 actuals versus the board-approved budget

completed.description: Loaded the Q3 GL extract and the approved budget; confirmed the total overage of $2,310,412.
Ranked cost centers by variance. Three account for 78% of the overage: 310 Cloud Infrastructure, 220 Contractors, 450 Facilities.
Quantified the cloud driver: $1.02M, of which $640k is a committed-use discount that lapsed on 2026-07-01 and was not renewed until 2026-08-15.

focus.description: Contractor spend in cost center 220: separating backfill for open headcount from new project work.

next.description: Split cost center 220 variance between headcount backfill and project work using the HRIS open-requisition report.
Quantify the facilities driver; check whether the Denver lease escalation was budgeted.
Assemble the bridge and reconcile to $2,310,412.
List items needing the controller's judgment, including the lapsed discount's classification.

statements.text: Only break out drivers over $50k; group the rest as 'other'.
Write for a board audience: no account numbers in the narrative, put them in the appendix.
Read-only access to finance systems; do not post journal entries or change budget data.
Compare against the board-approved budget (version B2), not the reforecast.
statements.rationale: The board pre-read reports against the approved budget.

statements.text: Translate EUR cost centers at the budget rate so FX does not appear as an operating driver; report FX separately.
statements.rationale: Keeps operating drivers comparable to budget; FX impact is $84k and is shown as its own line.

statements.text: Cloud infrastructure spend exceeded budget by $1,021,880; $640,200 of that is list-price billing between 2026-07-01 and 2026-08-15 when the committed-use discount had lapsed.

verification.method: summed invoice line items at list versus contracted rates

statements.text: Cost center 220 contractor spend exceeded budget by $498,300.

verification.method: summed GL account 6410 for cost center 220

statements.text: Most of the contractor overage is backfill for six engineering requisitions open since Q2.
The facilities overage is the Denver lease escalation, which may have been left out of the budget.
Should the lapsed-discount cost be presented as a one-time item or as operating spend?
Vendor account manager's note on the cloud invoice: 'Renewal delayed at customer request.'
